Let's break down what needs to be done for this task. The user wants to add the ability to:

1. Save an Assistant Response message (from MindMapMessages.tsx) as a session-note in session-notes.tsx
2. Extend the functionality to save the session note as a user-note in the Xata table
3. Use tiptap note rich text editor style for this

Let's examine the files we have:

1. MindMapMessages.tsx - This file contains the UI for displaying messages in the mind map. I need to add a way to save assistant messages as session notes.
2. session-notes.tsx - This file has the session notes UI. We need to modify it to accept new notes created from assistant messages.
3. mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx - This seems to be a related file that might be helpful to understand the context and flow.

Looking at the MindMapMessages component:
- It renders a list of messages with different parts (text, source, reasoning, tools)
- It doesn't currently have any save functionality
- I need to add a button or UI element to save an assistant message as a session note

Looking at the SessionNotes component:
- It has a structure for notes with id, title, content, tags, timestamp, isPinned
- It has functions for creating notes, toggling pins, etc.
- I need to integrate it with MindMapMessages

First, I'll need to add a button or UI element to each assistant message in MindMapMessages that when clicked will save the message as a session note. Then I'll need to create a function to handle this save action, which would need to:

1. Extract the relevant information from the message
2. Format it as a session note
3. Save it to the session notes
4. Potentially also save it to the Xata table for user notes

Since we'll need to add communication between these components, we'll likely need to use a context, props, or a state management solution to pass the save function from SessionNotes to MindMapMessages.

Additionally, for the rich text editor functionality, we'll need to consider how to convert the message content to a format compatible with tiptap.

Let me plan the implementation:

1. Add a "Save as Note" button to assistant messages in MindMapMessages.tsx
2. Create a function to handle saving a message as a note
3. Modify SessionNotes.tsx to accept notes from other components
4. Add integration with Xata table for user notes 
5. Implement rich text editor functionality if needed

Since we currently don't have specific information about the Xata table or the tiptap integration, I'll focus on steps 1-3 first and provide suggestions for steps 4-5.</details></think>

+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import type React from 'react'
+ import {createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo} from 'react'
+ import type {Message} from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu/MindMapMessages'
+ import type {Note} from '@/features/mindmap/components/status-ui/session-notes'
+ import {useToast} from '@/components/ui/use-toast'
+ 
+ // Interface for Xata save options
+ interface SaveToXataOptions {
+   title: string
+   content: string
+   tags: string[]
+   richText?: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ // Context interface
+ interface SessionNotesContextValue {
+   notes: Note[]
+   selectedNote: Note | null
+   isOpen: boolean
+   isNestedOpen: boolean
+   setIsOpen: (isOpen: boolean) =&gt; void
+   setIsNestedOpen: (isOpen: boolean) =&gt; void
+   setSelectedNote: (note: Note | null) =&gt; void
+   addNote: (note: Partial&lt;Note&gt;) =&gt; Note
+   addNoteFromMessage: (message: Message) =&gt; Note
+   saveToXata: (options: SaveToXataOptions) =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;
+   togglePin: (id: string) =&gt; void
+ }
+ 
+ // Create the context
+ const SessionNotesContext = createContext&lt;SessionNotesContextValue | undefined&gt;(undefined)
+ 
+ // Provider component
+ export const SessionNotesProvider: React.FC&lt;{children: React.ReactNode}&gt; = ({children}) =&gt; {
+   const [notes, setNotes] = useState&lt;Note[]&gt;([])
+   const [selectedNote, setSelectedNote] = useState&lt;Note | null&gt;(null)
+   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
+   const [isNestedOpen, setIsNestedOpen] = useState(false)
+   const {toast} = useToast()
+ 
+   // Load notes from localStorage on mount
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     try {
+       const savedNotes = localStorage.getItem('session-notes')
+       if (savedNotes) {
+         const parsedNotes = JSON.parse(savedNotes)
+         if (Array.isArray(parsedNotes) &amp;&amp; parsedNotes.length &gt; 0) {
+           setNotes(parsedNotes)
+         }
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('Error loading notes from localStorage:', error)
+     }
+   }, [])
+ 
+   // Save notes to localStorage whenever they change
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (notes.length &gt; 0) {
+       localStorage.setItem('session-notes', JSON.stringify(notes))
+     }
+   }, [notes])
+ 
+   // Toggle pin status for a note
+   const togglePin = useCallback((id: string) =&gt; {
+     setNotes((prev) =&gt;
+       prev.map((note) =&gt; (note.id === id ? {...note, isPinned: !note.isPinned} : note))
+     )
+   }, [])
+ 
+   // Add a new note
+   const addNote = useCallback((note: Partial&lt;Note&gt;): Note =&gt; {
+     const newNote: Note = {
+       id: &#96;note-${Date.now()}&#96;,
+       title: note.title || 'New Note',
+       content: note.content || '',
+       tags: note.tags || ['new'],
+       timestamp: note.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
+       isPinned: note.isPinned || false,
+       sourceMessageId: note.sourceMessageId,
+     }
+ 
+     setNotes((prev) =&gt; [newNote, ...prev])
+     return newNote
+   }, [])
+ 
+   // Add a note from a message
+   const addNoteFromMessage = useCallback(
+     (message: Message): Note =&gt; {
+       const newNote = addNote({
+         title: &#96;AI Response ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}&#96;,
+         content: message.content,
+         tags: ['ai-response', 'mind-map'],
+         sourceMessageId: message.id,
+       })
+ 
+       toast({
+         title: 'Note Added',
+         description: 'AI response saved as a session note',
+       })
+ 
+       // Open the drawer and show the new note
+       setIsOpen(true)
+       setSelectedNote(newNote)
+       setIsNestedOpen(true)
+ 
+       return newNote
+     },
+     [addNote, toast]
+   )
+ 
+   // Save a note to Xata
+   const saveToXata = useCallback(
+     async (options: SaveToXataOptions): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; =&gt; {
+       try {
+         // Mock implementation - in a real app, this would call your API
+         // const response = await fetch('/api/user-notes', {
+         //   method: 'POST',
+         //   headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+         //   body: JSON.stringify(options),
+         // })
+ 
+         // For demo purposes, simulate a successful API call
+         // if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to save to Xata')
+ 
+         toast({
+           title: 'Saved to Knowledge Base',
+           description: 'Note has been saved to your permanent knowledge base',
+         })
+ 
+         return true
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error('Error saving to Xata:', error)
+         toast({
+           title: 'Error',
+           description: 'Failed to save note to knowledge base',
+           variant: 'destructive',
+         })
+         return false
+       }
+     },
+     [toast]
+   )
+ 
+   // Create the context value
+   const contextValue = useMemo(
+     () =&gt; ({
+       notes,
+       selectedNote,
+       isOpen,
+       isNestedOpen,
+       setIsOpen,
+       setIsNestedOpen,
+       setSelectedNote,
+       addNote,
+       addNoteFromMessage,
+       saveToXata,
+       togglePin,
+     }),
+     [notes, selectedNote, isOpen, isNestedOpen, addNote, addNoteFromMessage, saveToXata, togglePin]
+   )
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;SessionNotesContext.Provider value={contextValue}&gt;{children}&lt;/SessionNotesContext.Provider&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ 
+ // Custom hook to use the context
+ export const useSessionNotes = (): SessionNotesContextValue =&gt; {
+   const context = useContext(SessionNotesContext)
+   if (context === undefined) {
+     throw new Error('useSessionNotes must be used within a SessionNotesProvider')
+   }
+   return context
+ }
+

@@ -1,1 +1,58 @@
- 
+ import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
+ import { getXataClient } from "@/db/xata";
+ 
+ // Define the expected request body structure
+ interface CreateNoteRequest {
+ 	title: string;
+ 	content: string;
+ 	tags: string[];
+ 	richText?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
+ 	try {
+ 		// Parse the request body
+ 		const data = (await request.json()) as CreateNoteRequest;
+ 
+ 		// Validate the required fields
+ 		if (!data.title || !data.content) {
+ 			return NextResponse.json(
+ 				{ error: "Title and content are required" },
+ 				{ status: 400 },
+ 			);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Initialize Xata client
+ 		const xata = getXataClient();
+ 
+ 		// Save the note to Xata
+ 		const newNote = await xata.db.userNotes.create({
+ 			title: data.title,
+ 			content: data.content,
+ 			richContent: data.richText ? data.content : null, // Use richText field if specified
+ 			tags: data.tags.join(","), // Store tags as comma-separated string
+ 			createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+ 			userId: "current-user-id", // Replace with actual user ID from auth
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		// Return the created note
+ 		return NextResponse.json(
+ 			{
+ 				success: true,
+ 				noteId: newNote.id,
+ 				message: "Note saved successfully",
+ 			},
+ 			{ status: 201 },
+ 		);
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error saving note to Xata:", error);
+ 		return NextResponse.json(
+ 			{
+ 				error: "Failed to save note",
+ 				details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
+ 			},
+ 			{ status: 500 },
+ 		);
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
```

  // Create the context
  const SessionNotesContext = createContext&lt;SessionNotesContextValue | undefined&gt;(undefined)

+ // Helper function to convert markdown to HTML for rich text
+ const markdownToHtml = (markdown: string): string =&gt; {
+   // This is a very basic implementation
+   // In a real application, you'd use a proper markdown parser like remark
+   return markdown
+     .replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '&lt;strong&gt;$1&lt;/strong&gt;') // Bold
+     .replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '&lt;em&gt;$1&lt;/em&gt;') // Italic
+     .replace(/\&#96;\&#96;\&#96;(.*?)\&#96;\&#96;\&#96;/gs, '&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code&gt;$1&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;') // Code blocks
+     .replace(/\&#96;(.*?)\&#96;/g, '&lt;code&gt;$1&lt;/code&gt;') // Inline code
+     .replace(/\n\n/g, '&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;') // Paragraphs
+     .replace(/\n/g, '&lt;br&gt;') // Line breaks
+     .replace(/#{3} (.*?)$/gm, '&lt;h3&gt;$1&lt;/h3&gt;') // H3
+     .replace(/#{2} (.*?)$/gm, '&lt;h2&gt;$1&lt;/h2&gt;') // H2
+     .replace(/# (.*?)$/gm, '&lt;h1&gt;$1&lt;/h1&gt;') // H1
+     .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '&lt;a href="$2"&gt;$1&lt;/a&gt;') // Links
+ }
  
  // Provider component

@@ -1,1 +1,177 @@
- 
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import * as React from 'react'
+ 
+ import type {ToastActionElement, ToastProps} from '@/components/ui/toast'
+ 
+ const TOAST_LIMIT = 5
+ const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000
+ 
+ type ToasterToast = ToastProps &amp; {
+   id: string
+   title?: React.ReactNode
+   description?: React.ReactNode
+   action?: ToastActionElement
+ }
+ 
+ const actionTypes = {
+   ADD_TOAST: 'ADD_TOAST',
+   UPDATE_TOAST: 'UPDATE_TOAST',
+   DISMISS_TOAST: 'DISMISS_TOAST',
+   REMOVE_TOAST: 'REMOVE_TOAST',
+ } as const
+ 
+ let count = 0
+ 
+ function genId() {
+   count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
+   return count.toString()
+ }
+ 
+ type ActionType = typeof actionTypes
+ 
+ type Action =
+   | {
+       type: ActionType['ADD_TOAST']
+       toast: ToasterToast
+     }
+   | {
+       type: ActionType['UPDATE_TOAST']
+       toast: Partial&lt;ToasterToast&gt;
+     }
+   | {
+       type: ActionType['DISMISS_TOAST']
+       toastId?: string
+     }
+   | {
+       type: ActionType['REMOVE_TOAST']
+       toastId?: string
+     }
+ 
+ interface State {
+   toasts: ToasterToast[]
+ }
+ 
+ const toastTimeouts = new Map&lt;string, ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt;&gt;()
+ 
+ const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State =&gt; {
+   switch (action.type) {
+     case actionTypes.ADD_TOAST:
+       return {
+         ...state,
+         toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
+       }
+ 
+     case actionTypes.UPDATE_TOAST:
+       return {
+         ...state,
+         toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =&gt; (t.id === action.toast.id ? {...t, ...action.toast} : t)),
+       }
+ 
+     case actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST: {
+       const {toastId} = action
+ 
+       // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
+       // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
+       if (toastId) {
+         if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
+           clearTimeout(toastTimeouts.get(toastId))
+           toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
+         }
+       } else {
+         for (const [id, timeout] of toastTimeouts.entries()) {
+           clearTimeout(timeout)
+           toastTimeouts.delete(id)
+         }
+       }
+ 
+       return {
+         ...state,
+         toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =&gt;
+           t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
+             ? {
+                 ...t,
+                 open: false,
+               }
+             : t
+         ),
+       }
+     }
+     case actionTypes.REMOVE_TOAST:
+       if (action.toastId === undefined) {
+         return {
+           ...state,
+           toasts: [],
+         }
+       }
+       return {
+         ...state,
+         toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) =&gt; t.id !== action.toastId),
+       }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ const listeners: ((state: State) =&gt; void)[] = []
+ 
+ let memoryState: State = {toasts: []}
+ 
+ function dispatch(action: Action) {
+   memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
+   listeners.forEach((listener) =&gt; {
+     listener(memoryState)
+   })
+ }
+ 
+ type Toast = Omit&lt;ToasterToast, 'id'&gt;
+ 
+ function toast({...props}: Toast) {
+   const id = genId()
+ 
+   const update = (props: ToasterToast) =&gt;
+     dispatch({
+       type: actionTypes.UPDATE_TOAST,
+       toast: {...props, id},
+     })
+   const dismiss = () =&gt; dispatch({type: actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST, toastId: id})
+ 
+   dispatch({
+     type: actionTypes.ADD_TOAST,
+     toast: {
+       ...props,
+       id,
+       open: true,
+       onOpenChange: (open) =&gt; {
+         if (!open) dismiss()
+       },
+     },
+   })
+ 
+   return {
+     id: id,
+     dismiss,
+     update,
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ function useToast() {
+   const [state, setState] = React.useState&lt;State&gt;(memoryState)
+ 
+   React.useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     listeners.push(setState)
+     return () =&gt; {
+       const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
+       if (index &gt; -1) {
+         listeners.splice(index, 1)
+       }
+     }
+   }, [state])
+ 
+   return {
+     ...state,
+     toast,
+     dismiss: (toastId?: string) =&gt; dispatch({type: actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST, toastId}),
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ export {useToast, toast}
+ 
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,192 @@
- 
+ // Inspired by react-hot-toast library
+ import * as React from "react";
+ 
+ import type { ToastActionElement, ToastProps } from "@/components/ui/toast";
+ 
+ const TOAST_LIMIT = 5;
+ const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;
+ 
+ type ToasterToast = ToastProps &amp; {
+ 	id: string;
+ 	title?: React.ReactNode;
+ 	description?: React.ReactNode;
+ 	action?: ToastActionElement;
+ };
+ 
+ const actionTypes = {
+ 	ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
+ 	UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
+ 	DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
+ 	REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
+ } as const;
+ 
+ let count = 0;
+ 
+ function genId() {
+ 	count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_VALUE;
+ 	return count.toString();
+ }
+ 
+ type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;
+ 
+ type Action =
+ 	| {
+ 			type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"];
+ 			toast: ToasterToast;
+ 	  }
+ 	| {
+ 			type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"];
+ 			toast: Partial&lt;ToasterToast&gt;;
+ 	  }
+ 	| {
+ 			type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"];
+ 			toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
+ 	  }
+ 	| {
+ 			type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"];
+ 			toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
+ 	  };
+ 
+ interface State {
+ 	toasts: ToasterToast[];
+ }
+ 
+ const toastTimeouts = new Map&lt;string, ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt;&gt;();
+ 
+ const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) =&gt; {
+ 	if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
+ 		return;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const timeout = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+ 		toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
+ 		dispatch({
+ 			type: actionTypes.REMOVE_TOAST,
+ 			toastId: toastId,
+ 		});
+ 	}, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);
+ 
+ 	toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
+ };
+ 
+ export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State =&gt; {
+ 	switch (action.type) {
+ 		case actionTypes.ADD_TOAST:
+ 			return {
+ 				...state,
+ 				toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
+ 			};
+ 
+ 		case actionTypes.UPDATE_TOAST:
+ 			return {
+ 				...state,
+ 				toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =&gt;
+ 					t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t,
+ 				),
+ 			};
+ 
+ 		case actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST: {
+ 			const { toastId } = action;
+ 
+ 			// ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
+ 			// but I'll keep it here for simplicity
+ 			if (toastId) {
+ 				addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
+ 			} else {
+ 				state.toasts.forEach((toast) =&gt; {
+ 					addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
+ 				});
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			return {
+ 				...state,
+ 				toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =&gt;
+ 					t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
+ 						? {
+ 								...t,
+ 								open: false,
+ 							}
+ 						: t,
+ 				),
+ 			};
+ 		}
+ 		case actionTypes.REMOVE_TOAST:
+ 			if (action.toastId === undefined) {
+ 				return {
+ 					...state,
+ 					toasts: [],
+ 				};
+ 			}
+ 			return {
+ 				...state,
+ 				toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) =&gt; t.id !== action.toastId),
+ 			};
+ 	}
+ };
+ 
+ const listeners: Array&lt;(state: State) =&gt; void&gt; = [];
+ 
+ let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };
+ 
+ function dispatch(action: Action) {
+ 	memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
+ 	listeners.forEach((listener) =&gt; {
+ 		listener(memoryState);
+ 	});
+ }
+ 
+ type Toast = Omit&lt;ToasterToast, "id"&gt;;
+ 
+ function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
+ 	const id = genId();
+ 
+ 	const update = (props: ToasterToast) =&gt;
+ 		dispatch({
+ 			type: actionTypes.UPDATE_TOAST,
+ 			toast: { ...props, id },
+ 		});
+ 	const dismiss = () =&gt;
+ 		dispatch({ type: actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST, toastId: id });
+ 
+ 	dispatch({
+ 		type: actionTypes.ADD_TOAST,
+ 		toast: {
+ 			...props,
+ 			id,
+ 			open: true,
+ 			onOpenChange: (open) =&gt; {
+ 				if (!open) dismiss();
+ 			},
+ 		},
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		id: id,
+ 		dismiss,
+ 		update,
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ function useToast() {
+ 	const [state, setState] = React.useState&lt;State&gt;(memoryState);
+ 
+ 	React.useEffect(() =&gt; {
+ 		listeners.push(setState);
+ 		return () =&gt; {
+ 			const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
+ 			if (index &gt; -1) {
+ 				listeners.splice(index, 1);
+ 			}
+ 		};
+ 	}, [state]);
+ 
+ 	return {
+ 		...state,
+ 		toast,
+ 		dismiss: (toastId?: string) =&gt;
+ 			dispatch({ type: actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST, toastId }),
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ export { useToast, toast };
+ 
```

        "contents": "\n\nfunction SortableListItem( {\n  item,\n  order,\n  onCompleteItem,\n  onRemoveItem,\n  renderExtra,\n  handleDrag,\n  isExpanded,\n  className,\n}: SortableListItemProps ) {\n  const [ref, bounds] = useMeasure()\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState( false )\n  const [isDraggable, setIsDraggable] = useState( true )\n  const dragControls = useDragControls()\n\n  const handleDragStart = ( event: any ) =\u003e {\n    setIsDragging( true )\n    dragControls.start( event, { snapToCursor: true } )\n    handleDrag()\n  }\n\n  const handleDragEnd = () =\u003e {\n    setIsDragging( false )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cmotion.div className={cn( '', className )} key={item.id}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className='flex w-full items-center'\u003e\n        \u003cReorder.Item\n          value={item}\n          className={cn(\n            'relative z-auto grow',\n            'h-full rounded-xl bg-[#161716]/80',\n            'shadow-[0px_1px_0px_0px_hsla(0,0%,100%,.03)_inset,0px_0px_0px_1px_hsla(0,0%,100%,.03)_inset,0px_0px_0px_1px_rgba(0,0,0,.1),0px_2px_2px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,.1),0px_4px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,.1),0px_8px_8px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,.1)]'\n\n            // item.checked \u0026\u0026 !isDragging ? 'w-7/10' : 'w-full'\n          )}\n          key={item.id}\n          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}\n          animate={{\n            opacity: 1,\n            height: bounds.height \u003e 0 ? bounds.height : undefined,\n            transition: {\n              type: 'spring',\n              bounce: 0,\n              duration: 0.4,\n            },\n          }}\n          exit={{\n            opacity: 0,\n            transition: {\n              duration: 0.05,\n              type: 'spring',\n              bounce: 0.1,\n            },\n          }}\n          layout\n          layoutId={&#96;item-${item.id}&#96;}\n          dragListener={!item.checked}\n          dragControls={dragControls}\n          onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}",

+ export type TodoItem = {

+   completed: boolean
+ }
+ 
+ export function Todo() {
+   const [todos, setTodos] = useState&lt;TodoItem[]&gt;([
+     {id: '1', text: 'Learn React', completed: true},

+     {id: '3', text: 'Style with Tailwind', completed: false},
+   ])
+   const [newTodo, setNewTodo] = useState('')
+ 
+   const addTodo = () =&gt; {
+     if (newTodo.trim() === '') return
+     setTodos([...todos, {id: uuidv4(), text: newTodo, completed: false}])
+     setNewTodo('')
+   }
+

+             placeholder='Add a new task...'
+             className='flex-1 bg-black/20 border-white/10 text-white'
+           /&gt;
+           &lt;Button onClick={addTodo} variant='outline' size='icon'&gt;

+           &lt;/Button&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;LayoutGroup&gt;
+           &lt;Reorder.Group axis='y' values={todos} onReorder={setTodos} className='space-y-2'&gt;
+             &lt;AnimatePresence&gt;
+               {todos.map((todo) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;Reorder.Item
+                   key={todo.id}
+                   value={todo}
+                   initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}}
+                   animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}
+                   exit={{opacity: 0, y: -10}}
+                   className={cn(
+                     'flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-md',
+                     'bg-black/40 border border-white/5',
+                     'cursor-move select-none'
+                   )}&gt;
+                   &lt;div className='flex items-center gap-3'&gt;
+                     &lt;Checkbox
+                       checked={todo.completed}
+                       id={&#96;todo-${todo.id}&#96;}
+                       onCheckedChange={() =&gt; toggleTodo(todo.id)}
+                       className='h-5 w-5 rounded-md border-white/20 bg-black/30 data-[state=checked]:bg-black data-[state=checked]:text-green-200'
+                     /&gt;
